title: penstemon incanus
intro: Penstemon incanus, commonly known as White Penstemon, is a perennial plant species belonging to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is native to the western United States and is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of White Penstemon include antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions.
